dmn_experiences.title: Newcastle Gin Tasting @ Bealim House
dmn_experiences.summary: A gin tasting at Bealim House, home to the Newcastle Gin Company and the city's only working in-house gin still. It covers the history of gin and finishes with a tasting of Newcastle gins.
highlights: Tasting of Newcastle London Dry and flavoured gins
Learn about the working in-house gin still

dmn_experiences.title: Cocktail Masterclass @ Bealim House
dmn_experiences.summary: A hands-on cocktail-making class at Bealim House. After a welcome drink, guests head behind the bar to make two cocktails of their choice using classic bartending techniques.
highlights: Make two cocktails of your choice
Learn shaking, muddling, stirring and layering
